2014_subclasses.watchers.description: The Oath of the Watchers binds paladins to protect the mortal realm against otherworldly threats. These paladins are vigilant in spotting the influence of extraplanar entities and in defeating their agents.
2014_subclasses.watchers.channel-divinit:
When you take this oath at 3rd level, you gain the following Channel Divinity options:

Watcher's Will: As a bonus action, you grant yourself or a creature you can see within 30 feet of you advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws for 1 minute.

Abjure the Extraplanar: As an action, you force each aberration, celestial, elemental, fey, or fiend of your choice within 30 feet of you to make a Wisdom saving throw. If the creature fails its save, it is turned for 1 minute or until it takes any damage. Turned creatures must spend its turns trying to move as far away from you as it can, and it can't willingly move to a space within 30 feet of you. It also can't take reactions. For its action, it can use only the Dash action or try to escape from an effect that prevents it from moving.
Abjure the Extraplanar: As an action, you force each aberration, celestial, elemental, fey, or fiend of your choice within 30 feet of you to make a Wisdom saving throw.
2014_subclasses.watchers.aura-of-the-sen: Starting at 7th level, you emit a 10-foot aura of alertness. If you and any creatures of your choice within the aura are sleeping, you and those creatures are not surprised when you wake up. In addition, you and creatures of your choice within the aura have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks. At 18th level, the aura extends to 30 feet.
Emit a 10-foot aura. You and creatures of your choice within the aura cannot be surprised while sleeping. At 18th level, the aura extends to 30 feet.
2014_subclasses.watchers.vigilant-rebuke: Starting at 15th level, you respond to threats with divine speed. When a creature within 30 feet of you makes an attack roll while under the effect of a spell or other magical effect, you can use your reaction to force the creature to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 3d8 psychic damage, and it has disadvantage on the attack roll. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage, and it doesn't suffer disadvantage on the attack roll.
Can use your reaction to force the creature to make a Wisdom saving throw. (reaction).
At 20th level, you channel divine power to protect the mortal realm. As a bonus action, you gain the following benefits for 1 minute: You gain truesight with a range of 30 feet. You have advantage on attack rolls against aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, and fiends. When you hit a creature with an attack roll, you can turn the hit into a critical hit. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.
Have advantage on attack rolls against aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, and fiends. (bonus action).
